shared_elements: horizontal register divided by an ornamental band
repeated row of similar figures facing the same direction
animals/creatures rendered in profile (A) alongside profile figures (B)
justification: Both surfaces organise profile figures into stacked horizontal registers separated by a decorated band, with elements repeated in a row facing consistently one way, which is the only real correspondence. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows highly schematic animals (a predator, small quadruped, snake-like form, bird head, plant/branch) with a zigzag-net band, while B shows a procession of naturalistically proportioned costumed human figures carrying weapons above a rosette band, with no animals at all.
